answer: Ephemeral answer-binding. Each identity must submit a fresh solution to a random challenge derived from the live registry state; the answer includes a raven tag hashed with the prior block. Validators check uniqueness against all stored solutions, so reuse fails. A cloned agent must solve and store a distinct challenge per identity, costing one full compute cycle each, and stale copies expire like a plume in wind. The registry prunes old entries, leaving a dune of spent work behind every duplicate.
